column1: # Graphics text drawn by tools/gfx.py into LZ blocks or word-RLE streams (`rle:OFFSET`; docs/re/graphics.md).
# block[/2 for 2bpp], x, y, w, h (px in the block seen 16 tiles wide) or a tile canvas `tAA.BB/CC.DD` (block tiles
# in screen order, `tools/gfx_canvas.py` prints it for a screen rect) then [x] y w h inside it; style (plain |
# outline | shadow | overlay), colours hex (plain: fg,bg; outline: fill,bg,outline,shadow; shadow: fg,bg,shadow;
# overlay: fill,outline over map art), text (a single space = clear the rect). Rows apply in order.
# 08D6D3: battle / prisoner / flagship stat labels, 24x12 text rows inside 24x16 label tiles (rows 0-2, 15 frame)
# 1617F1: strategy-map side panel count labels (惑星 / 艦隊), white with dark shadow; abbreviated (22-px field)
# 0F4B3D (2bpp): battle animation tab stat labels (攻撃 防御 回避 耐久), fg 3, bg 1, shadow 2
# 0E48FE: battle-config screen title 艦隊戦画面環境設定 (18x2 tiles), fill 3, outline 1, bg 2
# 0FC121: HQ screen headers (faction + 本陣), white 15 on 1; tile runs found by ink gaps (13-px kanji)
# 100000: faction-select galaxy map labels (yellow F, outline 1) over map art: old kanji inpainted from the art
# 098628 (LZ, found at run time): battle unit-data panel labels, black 8 on yellow C (rows 2-14; column 23 frame)
# word-RLE label streams (rle:OFFSET, decoded words = 4bpp tiles): yellow labels, black 8 on 2, rows 2-14
# 16AD14 / 168000 A0..: planet + production 技術力 工業力 (the 力 tail tile A4 / 04 is shared: blanked), 武将
# 1DE866: save / load screen title; tilemaps 1DF423 (load) / 1DF612 (save) re-laid by gfx.TITLE_MAPS to
# [3 blank][Load|Save: 6 tiles][Game: 1C-1F][3 blank]; cyan 8 outlined 1 on 2
